pastor.description: A person's role, shown over their name on the site and offered in the admin's editor: the pastor of the church.

elder.description: A person's role, shown over their name on the site and offered in the admin's editor: one of the church's elders.

staff.description: A person's role, shown over their name on the site and offered in the admin's editor: someone who serves the church in another capacity, such as in its office.

member.description: A person's role, offered in the admin's editor and shown in its list: someone who belongs to the church and holds no office in it. Members are not listed on the site.
